correctness.rationale: For a connected graph, return after two updates forces identical total vertex firing counts (graph Laplacian kernel); primitive period two makes that common count exactly one. The complementary phase constraints are equivalent to four explicit vertex interval types on K_a join independent b. Their shifted polynomial product counts each labelled state exactly once. An affine-in-l endpoint expression reduces to a discrete convex quadratic; endpoint minimizers are fully classified. Degree complement gives mass reflection, and one optimal phase product covers every integer between its minimum and reflected maximum. Two distinct exact programs were executed from the actual package directory: 3,178,320 literal confined configurations on ten graphs matched independent phase enumeration, and 132 parameter pairs satisfied all polynomial/reflection/support/endpoint/parity checks. The unrestricted theorem is proved analytically, not inferred from the finite experiments.

originality.rationale: The claimed invariant is the complete finite split-graph mass distribution of initially primitive-two synchronous periodic states and its sharp extremal support. Jiang 2010 gives the general equal-firing-count criterion and multipartite period possibilities, but not this labelled chip-height polynomial; Jiang–Scully–Zhang gives allowed firing words; Levine concerns complete graphs and activity. Dukes 2020 and Derycke–Dukes–Le Borgne 2024 share the graph but study sink-based Abelian sandpile recurrent states, which are not time-zero synchronous two-cycles. The 2026 all-graphs middle-stair announcement concerns eventual period, not this mass-resolved initial census. Local and published-finding corpus searches did not identify a dominating formula. The original 1992 Bitar–Goles full text remained inaccessible, so novelty confidence has a documented residual risk.

value.rationale: Conserved chip mass is the primary energy observable of the closed fixed-energy sandpile, and the complete split graph is a standard clique/independent-shore family. The claim determines all exact initially primitive-two populations for an infinite two-parameter family, proves a contiguous exact energy spectrum, and locates a structural sharp change at b=a: for b<a the mass minimizer uses an internally mixed clique firing phase, whereas for b>=a the extremizer is a completely opposed clique/independent firing pattern. Even/odd a+b govern endpoint populations. This natural complete classification is neither a graph relabeling nor an arbitrary small finite table.
